python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, io
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

def q(tag):
    return "{%s}%s" % (NS, tag)

src = zipfile.ZipFile("sales_data.xlsx")
entries = {n: src.read(n) for n in src.namelist()}
src.close()

sheet = ET.fromstring(entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"])
rows = sheet.find(q("sheetData")).findall(q("row"))

# --- Extract per-row C (units), D (price), F (cost/unit) and compute margins ---
vals = {}
for row in rows:
    rn = int(row.get("r"))
    d = {}
    for c in row.findall(q("c")):
        col = c.get("r")[0]
        v = c.find(q("v"))
        if v is not None and v.text is not None and v.text.strip() != "":
            d[col] = float(v.text)
    vals[rn] = d

margins = {}
E_total = G_total = 0.0
for rn in range(2, 10):
    C, D, F = vals[rn]["C"], vals[rn]["D"], vals[rn]["F"]
    E = C * D
    G = E - C * F
    E_total += E
    G_total += G
    margins[rn] = G / E
margins[10] = G_total / E_total

# --- Update dimension ---
sheet.find(q("dimension")).set("ref", "A1:H10")

# --- Add column H definition ---
cols = sheet.find(q("cols"))
col = ET.SubElement(cols, q("col"))
col.set("width", "14"); col.set("customWidth", "1"); col.set("min", "8"); col.set("max", "8")

# --- Header H1 (bold, light-blue like other headers, style 1) ---
row1 = rows[0]
c = ET.SubElement(row1, q("c"))
c.set("r", "H1"); c.set("s", "1"); c.set("t", "inlineStr")
is_ = ET.SubElement(c, q("is"))
t = ET.SubElement(is_, q("t")); t.text = "Profit Margin (%)"

# --- Formula cells H2:H10 with cached values (style 3 = 0.0% percent format) ---
for rn in range(2, 11):
    row = next(r for r in rows if int(r.get("r")) == rn)
    c = ET.SubElement(row, q("c"))
    c.set("r", "H%d" % rn); c.set("s", "3")
    f = ET.SubElement(c, q("f")); f.text = "G%d/E%d" % (rn, rn)
    v = ET.SubElement(c, q("v")); v.text = "%.12f" % margins[rn]

# --- Styles: add 0.0% number format (numFmtId 164) and new xf (index 3) ---
styles = ET.fromstring(entries["xl/styles.xml"])
numfmts = styles.find(q("numFmts"))
numfmts.set("count", "1")
nf = ET.SubElement(numfmts, q("numFmt"))
nf.set("numFmtId", "164"); nf.set("formatCode", "0.0%")
cellxfs = styles.find(q("cellXfs"))
cellxfs.set("count", "4")
xf = ET.SubElement(cellxfs, q("xf"))
xf.set("numFmtId", "164"); xf.set("fontId", "0"); xf.set("fillId", "0"); xf.set("borderId", "0")
xf.set("pivotButton", "0"); xf.set("quotePrefix", "0"); xf.set("xfId", "0")

def ser(el):
    return ET.tostring(el, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=False)

buf = io.BytesIO()
out = zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for n, data in entries.items():
    if n == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
        data = ser(sheet)
    elif n == "xl/styles.xml":
        data = ser(styles)
    out.writestr(n, data)
out.close()

with open("sales_data.xlsx", "wb") as fh:
    fh.write(buf.getvalue())

print("written OK; margins:", {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in margins.items()})
PY
